five_hour_flow.visual_consistency: Combat HUD, parchment dungeon map and persistent objective strip now share a warm paper, ink and copper visual language.
five_hour_flow.cheap_web_ui: Glass-pill controls and dark modal framing were reduced; dungeon routes now read as an illustrated expedition map.
five_hour_flow.long_term_goal: The objective track derives the next milestone from real cards, loot, beasts, upgrades and best card quality after onboarding ends.
five_hour_flow.reward_peak: Dungeon node labels explain farm impact before selection, while high-quality cards continue to unlock explicit origin resonance rewards.
five_hour_flow.fatigue_risks: Reward icon specificity and mobile touch feel remain non-blocking P1 dogfood items.
